description.narrative: This project, implemented under the umbrella of the SALT Network (Spirituality, Accountability, Leadership, and Transformation), seeks to strengthen ethical and values-based governance in Kenya and the East African region. It aims to create a sustained shift in how institutions engage with governance, environmental, social, and leadership frameworks by embedding values-driven, informed principles. The project responds to the urgent need for more inclusive, ethical, and accountable leadership systems that resonate with local cultural and spiritual worldviews. In Kenya, governance systems often operate in technocratic silos that overlook the moral drivers influencing decisions at community level. At the same time, ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) frameworks remain dominated by global compliance standards, rarely contextualized to reflect African spiritual values or ethical heritage. The SALT Network was launched in 2024 with the support of Christian Aid Kenya, Christian Aid UK, and Strathmore University to provide a multi-stakeholder platform where faith-based actors, youth leaders, civil society, academia, and the private sector collaborate to co-create and pilot transformative models of governance and sustainability
